text: あのな…　わしの　おきにいりの　ギャロップがな…　…　…　でな…　が…　…　…　かわいくてな…　たまらん…　くう…　…　さらに…　もう…　すごすぎ…　…　で…　…　そう　おもうか…　どうして…　…　すき…　…　はー！

structure.jp: わしの　おきにいりの　ギャロップがな…
かわいくてな…　たまらん…
structure.en: it's so cute... I can't stand it...

structure.jp: くう…　…　さらに…　もう…　すごすぎ…
structure.en: ooh... what's more... just... too amazing...

structure.jp: …　で…　…　そう　おもうか…
どうして…　…　すき…　…　はー！

patterns.name: 〜てたまらない
patterns.span: かわいくてな…　たまらん
patterns.explanation: The て-form of a feeling word plus たまらない means the feeling is so strong you can't bear it. たまらん is the old-man short form. かわいくてな…　たまらん = 'it's so cute I can't stand it'.

patterns.name: 〜な (filler)
patterns.explanation: な dropped in between pieces of a sentence is a man's way of keeping the listener's attention, like 'you see'. ギャロップがな = 'my Rapidash, you see...'.

patterns.name: 〜すぎる
patterns.explanation: すぎる added to a describing word with its last い cut off means 'too much'. Here it is cut short itself. すごすぎ = 'too amazing'.
